I don’t want to tell anyone “don’t worry about elected officials spouting nonsense.” 

Sometimes you really do get a huge fuckup like Sam Brownback or Brandon Johnson in office, but most wildly unworkable ideas get ditched because they are unworkable.

The exact same structural parameters apply to all kinds of insane ideas from all political orientations — as a back-bench legislator or a candidate for office, talk is cheap and people say stuff. 

But governors and presidents and mayors are reality-constrained.

Sometimes Trump does crazy and self-destructive things (see the Strait of Hormuz or Liberation Day) but precisely because this 100 million deportation idea makes no sense, even people who are not big Trump fans sharply discount it as a possible outcome.

Case in point, this administration has repeatedly promised “100 million deportations” which would require removing tens of millions of lawful permanent residents and US citizens, shrink the population by over 25% and crash the economy.

There are other questions you could ask about climate change where the more more left-wing answer would be incorrect.
